sourceEntry: 2026-10-28 — Homepage drawer and returning customer actions
releaseSummary: Keep the rounded quick-start handle clear of homepage text. Pull down to open, pull up to close, tap outside or press Escape to dismiss. Approved portal customers see daily ordering, tracking and supply-shopping actions in place of trade-account prompts.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Homepage drawer and returning customer actions.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
